title:
Acid. nit. hydrochlor dil., 20 minims,
 Tinct. mix. vom., 4 minims.
 Extr. taraxel. lig., 30 minims.
 Aq. dis. ter in die.
html_source:
From Annotations to James Joyce’s Ulysses. Wikibooks (citing Gifford (1988)p 478.)

(Latin) Acidum nitro-hydrocloricum dilutum (Dilute nitro-hydrocloric acid, 20 drops)

(Latin) Tinctura nucis vomicae (Tincture of nux vomica, 5 drops). nux vomica is a stimulant prepared from the Strychnine tree

(Latin) Extractum taraxaci liquidum (Liquid extract of dandelion, 30 drops) This liquid extract is prepared from the dried dandelion root; it is prescribed as a stomachic and liver stimulant, often with diluted nitro-hydrochloric acid and tincture of nux vomica.

(Latin) Aqua distillata ter in die (Distilled water three times a day)
